entities.name: Aryl O-debenzylation
observations: The net transformation is cleavage of an aryl O-CH2-phenyl benzyl ether to the corresponding phenol; the remainder of the scaffold is unchanged.
Reactant formula is C26H23F2N3O5 and product formula is C19H17F2N3O5, consistent with loss of the benzyl substituent as C7H6 net.
